- [USER] Requested to write a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for an aerial lift safety program.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] SOP for Aerial Lift Safety Program includes the following sections: Purpose, Scope, Responsibilities, Procedures, References, and Review.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] SOP Purpose: Guidelines for the safe use of aerial lifts in the workplace.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] SOP Scope: Applies to all employees, contractors, and visitors using or working near aerial lifts on company property.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] SOP Responsibilities: Employees must follow procedures and report safety concerns; Supervisors ensure proper training and inspections; Safety Officer develops and monitors compliance.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] SOP Procedures include: Training, Pre-use Inspection, Operation, Safety Equipment, Emergency Procedures, and Reporting.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] SOP references OSHA Standard for Aerial Lifts (29 CFR 1926.453) and manufacturer's instructions.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] SOP Review: To be conducted annually by the Safety Officer and updated as necessary.
